parsed.seniority_signal: Senior AI Voicebot & Automation Engineer (all gender)
parsed.notes:
Candidate skills are taken from “Be our forward thinker”; technologies appearing only under “Make it happen” are excluded.
“idealerweise” makes the TTS/STT and Voice-AI-platform experience optional, including the platform examples.
Voicebots and Voice-AI platforms are treated as Conversational AI rather than separate taxonomy skills; the explicit required Conversational AI mention wins.
“cloud-nativen Architekturen” is mapped to cloud; no separate software-architecture requirement is inferred.
Python, JavaScript and TypeScript form the language alternatives. The optional platform examples have no taxonomy entries, so no additional multi-skill taxonomy alternative group is emitted.
